evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~3.01-3.03 Torr through the ramp and early growth at Ar 100 sccm.
Pressure has climbed steadily from 3.027 to 3.361 Torr since t=2640, about 0.1 Torr per 120 s and not levelling off.
Ar flow holds at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by extra inflow.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with steady heater power, so the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the atmosphere required for growth can't be checked.

args.missing_evidence: An O2 or leak-check reading would tell the two causes apart: a leak lets air in, a blockage does not. Other useful checks: the exhaust or pump line and the downstream valve position, and an isolated rate-of-rise test with Ar off.
